helpers.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.exists_above
helpers.source_header:
private theorem exists_above (xs : List Int) :
    ∃ z : Int, ∀ x ∈ xs, x < z

helpers.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.exists_below
helpers.source_header:
private theorem exists_below (xs : List Int) :
    ∃ z : Int, ∀ x ∈ xs, z < x

helpers.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.readPlan_run_from
helpers.source_header:
private theorem readPlan_run_from (input : Fin n → α) (compute : List α → β)
    (prior remaining : List (Fin n)) :
    Runs (readPlan (prior ++ remaining) compute) input
      (prior.map (fun i => (i, input i))).reverse
      (remaining.map (fun i => (i, input i)))
      (compute ((prior ++ remaining).map input))

helpers.name: Resources.Selection.length_value
helpers.source_header:
private theorem length_value (xs : List α) :
    (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs).1 = xs.length

helpers.name: Resources.Selection.partition_value
helpers.source_header:
private theorem partition_value (p : α) (xs : List α) :

helpers.name: Resources.Selection.strict_sizes
Resources.Selection.right_rank
helpers.source_header:
private theorem right_rank (p : α) (xs : List α) (k : Nat)
    (hk : k < xs.length)
    (he : ¬ k < (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (Partition.partitionRun p xs).1.1).1 +
      (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (Partition.partitionRun p xs).1.2.1).1) :
    k - (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (Partition.partitionRun p xs).1.1).1 -
        (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (Partition.partitionRun p xs).1.2.1).1 <
      (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (Partition.partitionRun p xs).1.2.2).1

helpers.name: Resources.Selection.medians_positive
Resources.Selection.medians_shorter
Resources.Selection.median_rank
helpers.source_header:
private theorem median_rank (d : Nat) (xs : List α)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hx : 0 < xs.length) :
    ((xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) - 1) / 2 <
      (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (chunkMediansRun d xs).1).1

helpers.name: Resources.Selection.selectWorker
helpers.source_header:
private def selectWorker (d cutoff : Nat) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff)
    (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (nr : Measured Nat Nat)
    (hn : nr = SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs) (hk : k < nr.1) :
    Measured {a // a ∈ xs} Nat

helpers.name: Resources.Selection.observe
helpers.source_header:
private def observe {xs : List α} (r : Measured {a // a ∈ xs} Nat) :
    Measured (Option α) Nat

helpers.name: Resources.Selection.worker_observe
helpers.source_header:
private theorem worker_observe (d cutoff : Nat) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff)
    (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (nr : Measured Nat Nat)
    (hn : nr = SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs) (hk : k < nr.1) :
    selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc k xs = observe (selectWorker d cutoff hd hc k xs nr hn hk)

helpers.name: Applications.Selection.sum_le_count_split
helpers.source_header:
private theorem sum_le_count_split {β : Type v} (zs : List β)
    (cost : β → Nat) (bad : β → Bool) (small big : Nat) (hs : small ≤ big)
    (hc : ∀ z ∈ zs, cost z ≤ if bad z then big else small) :
    (zs.map cost).sum ≤ small * zs.length + (big - small) * zs.countP bad

helpers.name: Applications.Selection.chunk_count_bound
helpers.source_header:
private theorem chunk_count_bound (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (r bad : α → Bool)
    (hd : 0 < d)
    (hmed : (chunkMedians d xs).countP bad ≤ (xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) / 2)
    (hgood : ∀ ys (hy : ys ∈ chop d xs),
      bad (lowerMedianValue ys (chop_mem_ne_nil d xs ys hy)) = false →
        ys.countP r ≤ d / 2) :
    xs.countP r ≤ d / 2 * (xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) +
      (d - d / 2) * ((xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) / 2)

helpers.name: Applications.Sequences.Chunks.ceilDiv_sub_add_one
helpers.source_header:
private theorem ceilDiv_sub_add_one (n d : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hd : 0 < d) :
    n ⌈/⌉ d = (n - d) ⌈/⌉ d + 1
